prompts.new: Solo guqin, Chinese seven-string zither. Pounding Clothes (捣衣). On an autumn night under the moon, women pound cloth for winter clothes to send to men far away. 秋夜月下妇人捣衣，为远方亲人赶制冬衣，凄婉思念。 Mood: longing, melancholy. Scene: autumn, moonlit night. 意境：思念、忧伤、秋、月夜。 Pentatonic mode, gong on D: D, E, F#, A, B. 五声调式，D 宫。

prompts.new: Solo guqin, Chinese seven-string zither. Night Mooring on the Autumn River (秋江夜泊). Scene: autumn, river, night. 意境：孤寂、秋、江河、夜。 Pentatonic mode, gong on G#: G#, A#, C, D#, F. 五声调式，G# 宫。
